recognize_zh: 高倍抹片中箭頭指的紅血球裡血紅素濃縮成深色、邊緣平直的結晶，並有指狀突起伸出細胞外，旁邊是明顯的靶形紅血球與濃縮的三角形細胞，這是 HbSC 結晶的特寫。
features: Dense hemoglobin crystals with blunt, straight-edged, finger-like projections (arrows)
Crystal-containing cells with pale residual cytoplasm
Numerous target cells with central hemoglobin dot
Dense irregularly contracted/triangular cells and a folded cell
Occasional platelets; a large polychromatic cell
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at high power shows red cells with dense hemoglobin crystals having straight edges and blunt, finger-like projections extending beyond the cell outline (arrows). The background contains numerous target cells, dense irregularly contracted cells and a polychromatic red cell. Classic thin sickle cells are not present in this field. Findings are consistent with hemoglobin SC disease with characteristic SC crystals.

ddx.vs: HbC crystals are single hexagonal or rhomboid rods with parallel sides lying within the cell, without the multiple finger-like projections of SC crystals.
HbSS sickle cells are thin, curved and pointed at both ends rather than dense blunt crystalline forms.
Schistocytes are small uniformly dense fragments with sharp torn edges, without a crystal inside a pale membrane ghost.
